changes.historical_text: Only once during each of your Standby Phases, you can pay 700 Life Points to activate this card's effect. Switch the ATK and DEF of 1 Warrior-Type or Machine-Type monster on your side of the field until the end of your opponent's next End Phase. When this card is destroyed, the effect is negated.
changes.modern_text: Once during each of your Standby Phases: You can pay 700 LP, then target 1 Warrior or Machine monster you control; switch the current ATK and DEF of that target until the end of your opponent's next turn.
